neighbours.label: a capital T or Т split off as its own token at the start of a name or word (' T|arek', ' Т|имур'), as opposed to names starting with another letter or staying whole
fire: The committee met in Thimphu. Tshering gave the opening speech.
In the final climb, Tadej attacked and nobody could follow.
Everyone at the clinic trusts Tarek with the difficult patients.
Our neighbour Tunde brought soup when we were ill.
Мы долго ждали на вокзале. Тимур приехал только вечером.
Об этом вчера заявил Трамп на пресс-конференции.
Мы переехали прошлой осенью. Тверь нам очень нравится.
Все уже собрались в комнате. Тогда он начал рассказ.

short: split capital T / Т word start
notes: Tokenization checked for all fire names. Probes ranged 0.10 to 0.36, so the median rule is the risk. The card also lists 'た' pieces, which this label does not cover. One probe, 'Теперь' after a full Russian sentence, scored 0.00; I did not check how it tokenized.
